statements.t: Since the close of the merger we announced supplying three prominent builders approximately 210,000 units to over 2500 homes including Maronda Homes, Home Creations and Stone Martin These follow recently announced builder initiatives where we could supply hundreds of thousands of units in India, Europe, the Middle East including Saudi Arabia and Egypt, the $4 billion mixed-use smart city development in the Little…
We also continue to pursue hospitality projects, international opportunities and technology licensing.

Management is focused on its path towards being cash flow positive, supported by expected annual cash expense savings of more than $6 million from the Deako merger and expansion across our sales channels.

risks.t: the Company’s ability to achieve positive cash flows and realize anticipated merger savings and other benefits
the Company’s ability to capture market share
the Company’s estimates of its potential addressable market and demand for its products and technologies
the Company’s ability to raise additional capital to support its operations as needed, which may not be available on acceptable terms or at all
the Company’s ability to continue as a going concern
the Company’s ability to execute on any sales and licensing or other strategic opportunities
risks arising from mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures and other collaborations
the Company’s ability to attract and retain key executives and qualified personnel
guidance provided by management, which may differ from the Company’s actual operating results

statements.t: We are continuing to refine our products and began manufacturing certain advanced and smart products in 2023 and expect additional products, including the third-generation smart-advanced platform to be available in early 2027.
We expect to manufacture the additional product offerings within the next few months.

We believe our total addressable market in the United States exceeds $500 billion, based on the Company’s internal calculations derived from the estimation of the total target user pool, projected average selling price, and projected units per household.
We believe that our revenues will be higher in 2026 than in 2025, primarily resulting from revenues from Deako’s acquired operations.
We believe that the cost of revenues will increase in 2026 compared to 2025, commensurate with an anticipated increase in revenues.
We believe that our selling and marketing expenses in 2026 will increase slightly but at a lower rate than the revenue growth when compared to 2025.

Under Topic 606, revenue is recognized when control of the promised goods or services is transferred to our customers, in an amount that reflects the consideration we expect to be entitled to in exchange for those goods or services.

estimates.name: Use of Estimates
estimates.t: The preparation of financial statements in conformity with GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the amounts reported in our financial statements and accompanying notes.

estimates.name: Fair Value of Financial Instruments
estimates.t: Disclosures about fair value of financial instruments require disclosure of the fair value information, whether or not recognized in the balance sheet, where it is practicable to estimate that value.

estimates.name: Revenue Recognition
estimates.t: We account for revenues in accordance with Accounting Standards Update No. 2014-09, “Revenue from Contracts with Customers” (Topic 606).
